name: agent-chain-wrapper
description: Run AgentChain as a CLI skill-style wrapper for reviewer-only checks from Codex, Kimi, and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Review current changes with another CLI.
interface.longDescription: Agent Chain Wrapper exposes this repository's AgentChain runner as a CLI skill-style wrapper. By default the current host CLI session writes code and AgentChain calls a selected external reviewer CLI, then the host applies feedback and repeats until approved. Fully delegated pairs remain available when explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Review my current changes with AgentChain and Kimi.
Use the current CLI session to code, then run AgentChain review.
Run AgentChain reviewer-only mode for this project.
